subject: Exec window preemption — need to resync Stratus Bank demo
message_1_subject: Intro demo — Stratus Bank — Mar 8 10:00 PT
message_1_body:
Hi team / Alex,

Confirming the live demo slot for Stratus Bank: Mar 8, 10:00 AM PT. This will be a 60-minute walkthrough covering Redwood hosted inference, Dedicated options, and our routing/cost controls.

Agenda (brief):
- 10m intro & objectives
- 25m live walkthrough (console + API)
- 15m Q&A (security/procurement questions)
- 10m next steps & mutual action items

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (for reference), calendar-invite.ics

If this works for Alex and procurement, I'll send a formal invite. Vanessa — can you confirm you can own the technical demo?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
message_2_subject: Re: Intro demo — Stratus Bank — Mar 8 10:00 PT
message_2_body:
On 2028-03-02 09:12, karthik_iyer wrote:
> Confirming the live demo slot for Stratus Bank: Mar 8, 10:00 AM PT.

Quick heads up — Vanessa is traveling that morning and her outbound flight overlaps the proposed window. Separately, Stratus ops mentioned an exec town hall the same morning that may pull key decision-makers.

Options I see:
- Move to Mar 9 (my preference) so we have full SE coverage and execs are likely available.
- Keep March 8 but compress to 30–45 minutes and have a backup SE (I can cover product intro).

Alex — if the exec presence is important, would you prefer Mar 9? If procurement needs to attend, we should avoid their typical weekly review slot (Thursdays, midday).

Apologies for the churn — want to make sure the right people see this.

— Soojin
Soojín Lee
Solutions Engineer Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
message_3_subject: Re: Intro demo — Stratus Bank — Mar 8 10:00 PT
message_3_body:
Hi all,

Thanks for the heads up. The exec town hall is critical for a few stakeholders — if that means Vanessa can't make it, I'd rather push the demo so the right technical folks are present.

My team is available:
- Mar 9 between 11:00 AM — 2:00 PM ET (convert to PT: 8:00 AM — 11:00 AM PT)
- Mar 10 after 1:00 PM ET

If you can do Mar 9 at 11:00 AM ET (8:00 AM PT), that works best on our side. Procurement is copied and prefers anything after 10:30 ET, but they can make an exception for this slot.

Alex Rogers
Senior PM, Stratus Bank
alex@stratusbank.com
message_4_subject: Re: Exec window preemption — need to resync Stratus Bank demo
message_4_body:
Thanks for the update team.

I agree we should prioritize full SE participation where possible — Vanessa's live walkthrough will make the demo stick. Vanessa, if you're unable to do Mar 9, can you confirm whether you can join remotely for a compressed 45-minute session? If not, we should lock Mar 9 11:00 ET as Alex requested and ensure notes & recording capture the deep-dive follow-up.

Proposed plan:
- Lock Mar 9 at 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT as the primary slot (per Alex).
- Vanessa to confirm remote availability; if she cannot, assign backup SE (I recommend Soojin to lead tech intro, Vanessa to record a 10–15 min pre-recorded segment we can play).
- Karthik to update the SOW and send updated calendar invite (45-minute invite; include recording permission).

I'll step in if procurement raises any blockers.

-Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
message_5_subject: Confirmed: Stratus Bank demo — Mar 9 11:00 AM ET (45m)
message_5_body:
All — thanks for the quick coordination.

Confirmed: Mar 9, 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT, 45 minutes. I've accepted and updated the calendar invite (new .ics attached).

Notes / action items:
- Vanessa: please confirm whether you can join live remotely. If not, please send a short recorded segment (10–15m) covering the model routing demo by EOD Mar 6 so we can slot it.
- Karthik: please update the SOW link with the revised timeline and share the HubSpot deal link in the invite.
- Alex / Procurement: if any additional folks need to join, reply-all with names and I'll add them to the invite.
